$comment: Declared repo map for the adoption manifest (arch step 2, S0).
Every producer/consumer test reference in adoption-manifest.json is written as
and its <repo_key> MUST appear here. check-adoption-manifest.mjs rejects unknown keys.
When OLUMI_ESTATE_ROOT is set (a directory containing sibling checkouts named
`local_dir`), the checker additionally asserts each referenced test FILE exists.
Without it, existence checking is reported as SKIPPED — loudly, never silently.
olumi-schemas is the ONLY repo in this estate whose `main` is live. It has no
`staging` branch at all. Every other repo integrates on `staging`, and its `main`
is months stale — CEE main 2026-01-20, UI main 2026-03-17, PLoT main 2026-02-25,
ISL main 2026-02-26, against staging HEADs all dated 2026-07-26. ISL staging HEAD
7d144c7fb is byte-for-byte the sha its live /health reports, so staging is what is
deployed. A test-existence or field-adoption check run against `main` on any of the
four services silently measures a five-month-old estate and reports a false verdict.
This was hit and corrected while building S0.

schemas.role: shared contract package (@talchain/schemas) — declares, never produces
schemas.ref_note: the only repo whose main is live; NO staging branch exists

cee.role: Cognitive Enhancement Engine — orchestrator + meaning layer
